haiku.problem: The tribe Paul came from is a minor detail. The remnant chosen by grace (2-2) or the seven thousand who did not bow to Baal (1-8) is clearly more central to the passage and was left out.
The question asks "Who did obtain it?" and the pronoun "it" points back to a thing that is not named in the question. It should name what Israel was seeking, as the rule on plain words requires.
